text:
lee: found a config that made the parser cry:
```yaml
app: recommendations
version: 2....0
```
lee: apparently 4 dots is a new major? :thinking_face:
nora: that is not a major that's a dramatic pause :drum:
kai: we should add a rule: if version contains an ellipsis > 2, send an empathic message :heart:
dev-bot: deploy blocked  invalid semver '2....0' (please consult your feelings) :x:
lee: i vote dev-bot replies with random pun when it blocks: "Semver? More like 'sem-verse'"
nora: also require a conformance test that rejects poetic versions. leave the art to poetry channel :wink:
kai: i'll open a tiny PR: add hook + test + optional haiku response. sample haiku from my morning coffee:
> silent CI waits
> three dots, then four, then sorrow
> please use 2.0.0
lee: perfect. can we make the haiku optional opt-in per team? :laughing:
